content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

The COREMERCH infrastructure works by leveraging free and paid tools to create a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery. This approach ensures that creators maintain full data ownership and are not dependent on any single platform. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, creators can build a robust and scalable digital commerce stack. This infrastructure is particularly useful for creators in countries where Stripe, PayPal, or other conventional payment platforms are unavailable or severely restricted.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying the COREMERCH infrastructure, creators need to have a clear understanding of their digital product offerings, target audience, and pricing strategy. They should also familiarize themselves with the various tools and technologies used in the infrastructure, such as GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and NOWPayments. Additionally, creators should ensure that they have a reliable internet connection and a computer or device with the necessary software and hardware requirements. By having these elements in place, creators can smoothly deploy and configure their digital commerce stack.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up the payment and delivery pipeline is a critical step in deploying the COREMERCH infrastructure. Creators need to integrate NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, into their online store. This involves generating an API key, configuring the payment gateway, and testing the payment processing workflow. Additionally, creators need to set up their digital product delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring that products are delivered instantly and securely to customers upon payment confirmation. By using NOWPayments, creators can benefit from a 0.5% fee, significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by Gumroad.
The COREMERCH infrastructure enables creators to maintain full data ownership and avoid platform fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once the payment and delivery pipeline is set up, creators can go live with their online store and start processing transactions. The first transaction is a critical milestone, as it validates the entire infrastructure and ensures that the payment processing and product delivery workflows are functioning correctly. Creators should test their store thoroughly, simulating various payment scenarios and verifying that products are delivered correctly. By successfully processing their first transaction, creators can build confidence in their digital commerce stack and start marketing their products to their target audience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As the online store gains traction, creators need to scale their infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales volume. This involves optimizing their GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting, upgrading their Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic, and expanding their Supabase or Google Sheets order storage. Creators should also monitor their NOWPayments transaction fees, which remain at 0.5% regardless of sales volume. By scaling their infrastructure efficiently, creators can ensure that their online store remains robust, secure, and performant, supporting their growing business needs. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, the fee difference between NOWPayments and Gumroad retains $921, making it a critical factor in scaling a profitable digital commerce business.

This kit includes all 6 blueprints, all 7 templates, and instant access to the necessary tools and technologies. By visiting the COREMERCH shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, creators can purchase the Complete Builder Kit and start building their online store. With this kit, creators can ensure that they have everything needed to deploy and scale a robust and profitable digital commerce business.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy the COREMERCH infrastructure, creators should start by setting up their GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages hosting, then configure their Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend logic. Next, they should integrate NOWPayments and set up their digital product delivery pipeline using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Creators should also test their store thoroughly, simulating various payment scenarios and verifying that products are delivered correctly. Additionally, they should monitor their transaction fees and scale their infrastructure as needed to ensure that their online store remains robust, secure, and performant. By following these steps, creators can successfully deploy and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the fee charged by NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a 0.5% fee on every transaction, significantly lower than the fees charged by conventional platforms like Gumroad.
Can I use the COREMERCH infrastructure to sell ebooks and courses?
Yes, the COREMERCH infrastructure is designed to support the sale of various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and more.
Do I need to have programming knowledge to deploy the COREMERCH infrastructure?
While programming knowledge can be helpful, it is not required to deploy the COREMERCH infrastructure. The Complete Builder Kit includes all the necessary tools and templates to get started.
How do I scale my infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales volume?

To scale your infrastructure, you should optimize your hosting, upgrade your backend logic, and expand your order storage. You should also monitor your transaction fees and adjust your pricing strategy as needed.
What is the difference between the Sovereign Starter Stack and the Edge Commerce Stack?

The Sovereign Starter Stack is a basic deployment package, while the Edge Commerce Stack is a more advanced package that includes additional features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing.
